title: AG60115: Plant Nutrition
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

The concept of rhizosphere, changes in soil bulk density, salt concentration,
complementary ions and aeration at the root soil interface, associated
microorganisms and their contribution to nutrient availability in the
rhizosphere, Movement of ions from soil to roots, soil factors affecting ion
transportation uptake kinetics of root system and factors affecting influx at
the root, Growth pattern and distribution of plant roots, root hairs, root
exudates and ion uptake, methods of evaluating root system along with root
morphological parameter; Modelling nutrient uptake in soil-plant system.
